additional_info.subject: RE: ID0425642-DC/Si-D/NL-[ MP / N0 170000001] VendorErrorCode CRM:02889000004
additional_info.body:
Hi Erik/Monica,
We have analyzed the logs and found that the issue appears to be related to EcoG. There are more than 1,000 entries showing an EcoG error with the message:
SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'I' in JSON at position 3002
.
As a hotfix, we suggest enabling the automatic reboot option daily. Could you please confirm with the customer what time would be suitable for scheduling the automatic reboot, ensuring it does not interfere with any active charging sessions?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
